identity: WebAuthn relying party ID — must exactly match the hostname served over HTTPS.
WebAuthn expected origin — the full HTTPS origin where the Lively world is served.

Origin of the identity vault iframe (Encryption.md §19.5), e.g. https://vault.dev.tinylil.world. Its host must equal identityRpId or be a subdomain of it, and the server must be reachable on that host (the vault app origin allow-list is derived from the Host: 'vault.' + the app host; IDENTITY_VAULT_APP_ORIGINS adds more). Unset = off: the KEK and X25519 key stay in this page's memory as before.

If true the vault ceremony always runs from a click inside the vault frame instead of trying a plain postMessage first (only needed if a browser refuses cross-origin ceremonies without a user gesture in the frame).

How this page reaches the identity vault. Unset (default): it creates the vault iframe itself from identityVaultOrigin. 'parent': this page is itself embedded in the page that hosts the vault, so the vault protocol is posted to window.parent (whose origin must be identityVaultOrigin) and that page forwards it to the vault; a request to show the vault's unlock button is sent to the parent as {keo:1, op:'vault.frame', args:{shown}}. Used when the world runs sandboxed inside the extension shell.
wallet: Origin the Wallet Vault iframe is served from (e.g. https://vault.tinylil.world). Its host must equal identityRpId or be a subdomain of it (the browser checks the rpId against the iframe's own origin, so a sibling like vault.tinylil.world fails when identityRpId is dev.tinylil.world; use vault.dev.tinylil.world, or change identityRpId to the shared parent domain, which orphans existing credentials; WalletSpec.md §3.2). Unset = reduced-isolation same-origin dev fallback — never leave unset in production.
Ethereum mainnet JSON-RPC endpoint. REQUIRED for balance/send — no default shipped (WalletSpec.md §12, §14 item 1). Set a real value in localconfig.js, not here.

Sepolia testnet JSON-RPC endpoint, for the plain-wallet (balance/send) network switcher only — deposit/withdraw/exit stay locked to Ethereum mainnet regardless of this setting, since the Privacy Pools contracts/ASP below have no known Sepolia deployment. No default shipped here; set a real value in localconfig.js.

Association Set Provider HTTP API base URL (WalletSpec.md §6.3, §12, §15 step 5). Real production host — live-verified from a browser at this app's own origin, including CORS preflight for the custom X-Pool-Scope header every call needs. No auth required. core/servers/ASPStubServer.js (/nodejs/ASPStubServer) remains available as an offline/no-network fallback — point this at it instead if working without internet access; that stub always reports an empty association set, never a real one.

Relayer HTTP API base URL, implementing WalletSpec.md §6.5's confirmed /relayer/quote, /relayer/request, /relayer/details contract. Set to the local RelayerStubServer.js (/nodejs/RelayerStubServer) for development; that stub errors on /relayer/request rather than broadcasting anything. Direct-submission withdrawal needs no relayer at all.

Privacy Pools Entrypoint proxy contract address on Ethereum mainnet (WalletSpec.md §12, §15 step 7). Live-verified via assetConfig()/scopeToPool() against ethereumRpcUrl. Note: an earlier draft of §12's own table had the same underlying hex digits with an invalid EIP-55 checksum (wrong letter-casing) — this value is the corrected checksum. The Entrypoint is UUPS-upgradeable and pools are added/removed by governance — re-verify against the live deployments manifest periodically rather than trusting this indefinitely.

PrivacyPoolSimple (native ETH) contract address on Ethereum mainnet (WalletSpec.md §12). SCOPE() is queried at runtime from this address rather than hardcoding the scope value, per this doc's own preference for querying over hardcoding.
